name: kira-mind-bot
description: Personal Telegram assistant bot for message analysis and reminders

scripts.start: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run start:prod; else npm run start:dev; fi
scripts.test: npm run build:server && npm run test:unit && npm run test:built-server-runtime && npm run test:ts:all && npm run test:ai-preset-availability && npm run test:memory-embedding-http && npm run test:admin-monitoring && npm run test:server-common && npm run test:multi-instance-compose
scripts.typecheck: npm exec tsc -- --noEmit --project tsconfig.server.json && npm --prefix admin-panel exec tsc -- -b
scripts.build:server: tsc --project tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p dist/utils && cp utils/legacyPersonalitySanitizer.js dist/utils/legacyPersonalitySanitizer.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin
scripts.test:admin-monitoring: node scripts/testAdminMonitoring.js && node scripts/testAdminAiUsageAnalytics.js && node scripts/testAdminPersonality.js && npm run test:admin-memory-graph
